findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/events.js::witness-absent refusal produces the stricter whole-file verdict, framed as a dos
findings.title: witness-absent refusal produces the stricter whole-file verdict, framed as a DoS
findings.disposition_rationale: By design: an absent witness falls back to whole-file (gates every row) — the SAFE, stricter direction the spec mandates (§ edge cases). A PR deleting its own anchor witness only makes its OWN merge stricter; not an opened hole.

occurrences.title: witness-absent refusal produces the stricter whole-file verdict, framed as a DoS

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/events.js::ledgerisbound fold is flippable by re-minting from an edited run-ledger + fresh ledger-write
findings.title: ledgerIsBound fold is flippable by re-minting from an edited run-ledger + fresh ledger-write
findings.action: none — accepted risk per operator-ratified spec residual
findings.disposition_rationale: The spec names this EXACT residual (lines 255/802): an actor who rewrites events.jsonl and rehashes run-ledger.json into a FRESH ledger-write row produces a coherent forged anchor — accepted by operator decision 2026-10-21. mintIssueAnchor byte-copies (never recomputes the fold), so the forgery is the named wholesale-anchor-control residual, not a new one.

occurrences.title: ledgerIsBound fold is flippable by re-minting from an edited run-ledger + fresh ledger-write

findings.title: legacy-cutoff ts is a PR-editable timestamp
findings.action: none — accepted risk per operator-ratified spec residual
findings.disposition_rationale: The spec explicitly describes the run-dir leg as a run-close/local-feedback check, NOT a trusted gate (line 387/403): it runs the PR-authored in-checkout binary and cannot fire in faff CI (.faff/runs gitignored). Backdating is the named wholesale-forgery residual; the cost is a wrong signal on an untrusted local leg, never a CI bypass. Accepted risk.

occurrences.title: legacy-cutoff ts is a PR-editable timestamp

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/events.js::whitespace-only issue is writable by the current writer, contradicting the faff-1353 assumes
findings.title: whitespace-only issue is writable by the current writer, contradicting the FAFF-1353 Assumes
findings.disposition_rationale: Designed behavior: the spec (line 220) explicitly notes issueScopedViolations accepts whitespace-only, which is PRECISELY why classify_row routes it to UNADMITTED_ISSUE (gating in every anchor). The Assumes covers absent/null/empty; whitespace is a separate, handled class. No contract violation.

occurrences.title: whitespace-only issue is writable by the current writer, contradicting the FAFF-1353 Assumes

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/evidence.js::singleissue uses admitted union outcomes keys, treating a 1-admitted run with a stray outcome as multi-issue
findings.title: singleIssue uses admitted UNION outcomes keys, treating a 1-admitted run with a stray outcome as multi-issue
findings.disposition_rationale: Matches the spec definition exactly: the ledger issue set is the union of admitted and outcomes keys (§ vocabulary; resolve_scope), the same set anchor-run derives its mint loop from. An issue with an outcome genuinely has an anchor, so the hostage argument holds; not a gap.

occurrences.title: singleIssue uses admitted UNION outcomes keys, treating a 1-admitted run with a stray outcome as multi-issue

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/governance-check.js::run-dir leg detail is not escapeworkflowdata-escaped on the --summary-md path
findings.title: run-dir leg detail is not escapeWorkflowData-escaped on the --summary-md path
findings.disposition_rationale: summary-md is $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY markdown, not a workflow command; only stdout ::error:: lines are workflow commands, and renderGovernanceCheckAnnotations applies escapeWorkflowData to the whole reason (incl. detail). An accepted scope value is token-shape-gated so it can never carry ::/%/control chars. The DoD injection AC (FAFF-1::error::injected) passes.

occurrences.title: run-dir leg detail is not escapeWorkflowData-escaped on the --summary-md path
